body.objective: Students will be able to describe festival customs.
successCriteria: I can describe customs of major Chinese festivals
I can explain reasons with 因为…所以…
I can compare festivals in China and Canada
body.hook: During Spring Festival, families put up red couplets, give red envelopes and eat dumplings. Every custom has a reason, and in Mandarin you explain reasons with 因为…所以… yīnwèi... suǒyǐ...: because..., therefore...

study.title: 中国的节日 Zhōngguó de jiérì
study.question: How are Chinese festivals celebrated, and why?
study.passage:
Festivals:
• 春节 Chūnjié (Spring Festival, Lunar New Year, January or February): family reunion dinner, dumplings 饺子 jiǎozi, red envelopes 红包, red decorations and couplets, fireworks. Red symbolizes luck and was said to scare away the monster Nián 年.
• 中秋节 Zhōngqiū jié (Mid-Autumn Festival, September or October): families admire the full moon and eat mooncakes 月饼 yuèbing; the round moon symbolizes family togetherness. Story of Cháng'é 嫦娥 who flew to the moon.
• 端午节 Duānwǔ jié (Dragon Boat Festival, June): dragon boat races and 粽子 zòngzi (sticky rice wrapped in leaves), remembering the poet Qū Yuán 屈原.
Grammar: 因为 A，所以 B: 因为红色代表好运，所以春节的时候人们用很多红色。Yīnwèi hóngsè dàibiǎo hǎoyùn, suǒyǐ Chūnjié de shíhou rénmen yòng hěn duō hóngsè. = Because red represents good luck, people use lots of red at Spring Festival.
短文:
中秋节是我最喜欢的节日。因为月亮又圆又亮，所以我们全家一起在外面看月亮。我们吃月饼，喝茶，聊天。因为奶奶住得很远，所以我们给她打电话。
Zhōngqiū jié shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiérì. Yīnwèi yuèliang yòu yuán yòu liàng, suǒyǐ wǒmen quánjiā yìqǐ zài wàimiàn kàn yuèliang. Wǒmen chī yuèbing, hē chá, liáotiān. Yīnwèi nǎinai zhù de hěn yuǎn, suǒyǐ wǒmen gěi tā dǎ diànhuà.
Task: Research one festival, then explain three customs with 因为…所以….
study.source: Original text written for this lesson; festival information summarized from cultural sources.
steps: Learn the 因为…所以… pattern
organizer: 加拿大的比较 Canadian comparison
discussion: Why is red so important at Spring Festival?
Why do families gather at Mid-Autumn?
Which Canadian holiday is most like Spring Festival?
Why do festivals keep old stories alive?
study.product: Create a festival guide in Mandarin for one Chinese festival: date, three customs explained with 因为…所以…, one food and one comparison with a Canadian holiday.

examples.title: Reason
examples.problem: Say "Because the moon is round, families get together."
examples.answer: 因为月亮很圆，所以家人在一起。
examples.explore: What does the round moon symbolize?

examples.title: Custom
examples.answer: A red envelope with money given to children and younger family members

examples.title: Food
examples.problem: What food is eaten at Dragon Boat Festival?
examples.answer: 粽子 zòngzi, sticky rice wrapped in leaves

examples.title: Comparison
examples.answer: Both bring families together for a big meal
